rows.text: Passenger [Trailblazer], your mail has been received.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Remember to sign it once you get back!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: This is a gift for the conductor. Open it up and check it out
Whoa. That's really caring of you, [Trailblazer]! Let's see what goodies are inside...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: It's a unique assortment from Penacony. Every piece tastes different
Feels like it did become sweeter...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Anyway. Thank you for your gift!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom
